Last week or so I bought an R9 280 from Gpushack and recently I've been having some issues with it. Normally I use a dual monitor setup (both via DVI) but today I wanted to play some Rocket League on my TV. I hooked it up via HDMI but I lost signal on one of my monitors. I unplugged the HDMI cable from my TV and got the signal back on my monitor, but when I plugged the HDMI cable back into the TV I couldn't get it to display anything. I've tried fiddling around with settings [although I haven't been able to do much](https://imgur.com/gT7xYC2) and reinstalling drivers multiple times but I haven't had any luck. Can anyone help me out here?

Specs:

* i3 4150 * R9 280 (duh) * 8 GB DDR3-1600 * Windows 10 Pro 64-Bit

EDIT: After doing some research and inspecting the card, I tried unplugging the monitor using the top DVI port (the one right next to the HDMI port) and this worked. I now have all displays working with one monitor using the bottom DVI port, the TV using HDMI, and the other monitor through Displayport with a VGA adapter.
